sources.title: Interact with the Hub through the Filesystem API — Docs
sources.snippet: Interact with the Hub through the Filesystem API In addition to the HfApi, the huggingface_hub library provides HfFileSystem, a pythonic fsspec-compatible file interface to the Model Database Hub. The HfFileSystem builds of top of the HfApi and offers typical filesystem style operations like cp, mv, ls, du, glob, get_file, and put_file. Usage
